# Generated by tools/build_minesweeper.py; regenerate instead of editing.
# Country/player scope only. Persistent mines/counts/state/frames arrays have
# 81 cells, indexed row-major 0..80. State: 0 hidden, 1 flag, 2 open, 3 queued.
# Status: 0 awaiting first reveal, 1 playing, 2 won, 3 lost, 4 queue fault.
# Only input callbacks perform work. No hourly/daily/global scan is registered.
# Candidates and flood queue are temporary; all pending cells settle before
# publishing the GUI snapshot. Closing the window keeps the saved board.

yzm_award_win = {
# Every board, from either entry: five PP, once for this board, no event.
# Board reset clears this marker; closing/reopening never does. No win limit.
if = {
 limit = {
  is_ai = no
  check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 2 compare = equals }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_opened value = 71 compare = equals }
  NOT = { has_country_flag = yzm_board_rewarded }
 }
 set_country_flag = yzm_board_rewarded
 add_political_power = 5
 add_to_variable = { yzm_wins = 1 }
}
}

yzm_invalidate = {
add_to_variable = { yzm_dirty = 1 }
}

yzm_coordinates = {
# Exact integer quotient: remove the remainder before dividing by nine.
set_temp_variable = { yzm_col = yzm_current }
modulo_temp_variable = { yzm_col = 9 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_row = yzm_current }
subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_row = yzm_col }
divide_temp_variable = { yzm_row = 9 }
}

yzm_count_neighbors = {
yzm_coordinates = yes
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 0 compare = greater_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -10 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -9 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 0 compare = greater_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -8 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -1 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 1 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 8 compare = less_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 8 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 9 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 8 compare = less_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 10 }
add_to_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_current = yzm_mines^yzm_neighbor }
}

}

if = {

yzm_enqueue = {
# Caller supplies yzm_neighbor. Mark on insertion, so no cell queues twice.
if = {
 limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_neighbor value = 0 compare = equals } }
 if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_tail value = 81 compare = less_than } }
  set_temp_variable = { yzm_queue^yzm_tail = yzm_neighbor }
  add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_tail = 1 }
  set_variable = { yzm_state^yzm_neighbor = 3 }
 }
 else = { set_variable = { yzm_status = 4 } }
}
}

yzm_queue_neighbors = {
yzm_coordinates = yes
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 0 compare = greater_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -10 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -9 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 0 compare = greater_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -8 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = -1 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 1 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 8 compare = less_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 8 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 9 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = 8 compare = less_than } check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = 8 compare = less_than } }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_current }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = 10 }
yzm_enqueue = yes
}

}

yzm_recount = {
set_temp_variable = { yzm_i = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
 limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_i value = 81 compare = less_than } }
 set_variable = { yzm_counts^yzm_i = 0 }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_current = yzm_i }
 yzm_count_neighbors = yes
 add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_i = 1 }
}
}

yzm_generate = {
# First reveal supplies yzm_input. Protect its clipped 3x3 neighborhood.
# Sample without replacement: exactly ten random draws, never rejection loops.
set_temp_variable = { yzm_current = yzm_input }
yzm_coordinates = yes
set_temp_variable = { yzm_first_row = yzm_row }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_first_col = yzm_col }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_min_row = yzm_row }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_max_row = yzm_row }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_min_col = yzm_col }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_max_col = yzm_col }
subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_min_row = 1 }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_max_row = 1 }
subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_min_col = 1 }
add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_max_col = 1 }
resize_temp_array = { array = yzm_candidates size = 81 value = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_remaining = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_gen_i = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
 limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_gen_i value = 81 compare = less_than } }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_current = yzm_gen_i }
 yzm_coordinates = yes
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { AND = {
   check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = yzm_min_row compare = greater_than_or_equals }
   check_variable = { var = yzm_row value = yzm_max_row compare = less_than_or_equals }
   check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = yzm_min_col compare = greater_than_or_equals }
   check_variable = { var = yzm_col value = yzm_max_col compare = less_than_or_equals }
  } } }
  set_temp_variable = { yzm_candidates^yzm_remaining = yzm_gen_i }
  add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_remaining = 1 }
 }
 add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_gen_i = 1 }
}
set_temp_variable = { yzm_placed = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
 limit = {
  check_variable = { var = yzm_placed value = 10 compare = less_than }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_remaining value = 0 compare = greater_than }
 }
 set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = yzm_pick min = 0 max = yzm_remaining integer = yes }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_chosen = yzm_candidates^yzm_pick }
 set_variable = { yzm_mines^yzm_chosen = 1 }
 subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_remaining = 1 }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_candidates^yzm_pick = yzm_candidates^yzm_remaining }
 add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_placed = 1 }
}
yzm_recount = yes
set_variable = { yzm_status = 1 }
}

yzm_begin_queue = {
resize_temp_array = { array = yzm_queue size = 81 value = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_head = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_tail = 0 }
}

yzm_drain_queue = {
# At most 81 visits. A mistaken chord queues mines and therefore can lose.
while_loop_effect = {
 limit = {
  check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 1 compare = equals }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_head value = yzm_tail compare = less_than }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_head value = 81 compare = less_than }
 }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_current = yzm_queue^yzm_head }
 add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_head = 1 }
 if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_mines^yzm_current value = 1 compare = equals } }
  set_variable = { yzm_exploded = yzm_current }
  set_variable = { yzm_status = 3 }
 }
 else = {
  set_variable = { yzm_state^yzm_current = 2 }
  add_to_variable = { yzm_opened = 1 }
  if = {
   limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_counts^yzm_current value = 0 compare = equals } }
   yzm_queue_neighbors = yes
  }
 }
}
if = {
 limit = {
  check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 1 compare = equals }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_opened value = 71 compare = equals }
 }
 set_variable = { yzm_status = 2 }
 set_variable = { yzm_flags = 10 }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_win_i = 0 }
 while_loop_effect = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_win_i value = 81 compare = less_than } }
  if = {
   limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_mines^yzm_win_i value = 1 compare = equals } }
   set_variable = { yzm_state^yzm_win_i = 1 }
  }
  add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_win_i = 1 }
 }
 yzm_award_win = yes
 # Only the PARQUET challenge caller is eligible for recruitment/super event.
 yz_parquet_minesweeper_first_win = yes
}
}

yzm_reveal = {
# yzm_input must be a cell index; flag and terminal guards are repeated here.
if = {
 limit = {
  is_ai = no
  check_variable = { var = yzm_input value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_input value = 81 compare = less_than }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 2 compare = less_than }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_input value = 0 compare = equals } }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 0 compare = equals } } yzm_generate = yes }
  add_to_variable = { yzm_steps = 1 }
  yzm_begin_queue = yes
  set_temp_variable = { yzm_neighbor = yzm_input }
  yzm_enqueue = yes
  yzm_drain_queue = yes
  yzm_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = {
   check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_input value = 2 compare = equals }
   check_variable = { var = yzm_counts^yzm_input value = 0 compare = greater_than }
  }
  set_temp_variable = { yzm_current = yzm_input }
  set_temp_variable = { yzm_near_flags = 0 }
  yzm_count_flags = yes
  if = {
   limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_near_flags value = yzm_counts^yzm_input compare = equals } }
   yzm_begin_queue = yes
   set_temp_variable = { yzm_current = yzm_input }
   yzm_queue_neighbors = yes
   if = {
    limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_tail value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
    add_to_variable = { yzm_steps = 1 }
    yzm_drain_queue = yes
    yzm_refresh = yes
   }
  }
 }
}
}

yzm_flag = {
if = {
 limit = {
  is_ai = no
  check_variable = { var = yzm_input value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_input value = 81 compare = less_than }
  check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 2 compare = less_than }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_input value = 0 compare = equals } }
  set_variable = { yzm_state^yzm_input = 1 }
  add_to_variable = { yzm_flags = 1 }
  add_to_variable = { yzm_steps = 1 }
  yzm_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_input value = 1 compare = equals } }
  set_variable = { yzm_state^yzm_input = 0 }
  subtract_from_variable = { yzm_flags = 1 }
  add_to_variable = { yzm_steps = 1 }
  yzm_refresh = yes
 }
}
}

yzm_left = {
if = {
 limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_mode value = 1 compare = equals } }
 yzm_flag = yes
}
else = { yzm_reveal = yes }
}

yzm_toggle_mode = {
if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_mode value = 0 compare = equals } } set_variable = { yzm_mode = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { yzm_mode = 0 } }
yzm_refresh = yes
}

yzm_refresh = {
# Frames: 1 cover, 2 blank, 3..10 numbers, 11 flag, 12 mine,
# 13 explosion, 14 wrong flag. Clear unfinished queue marks on loss/fault.
set_temp_variable = { yzm_view_i = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
 limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_view_i value = 81 compare = less_than } }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_view_i value = 3 compare = equals } } set_variable = { yzm_state^yzm_view_i = 0 } }
 set_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = 1 }
 if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_view_i value = 1 compare = equals } }
  set_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = 11 }
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_view_i value = 2 compare = equals } }
  set_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = yzm_counts^yzm_view_i }
  add_to_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = 2 }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 3 compare = equals } }
  if = {
   limit = {
    check_variable = { var = yzm_mines^yzm_view_i value = 1 compare = equals }
    NOT = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_view_i value = 1 compare = equals } }
   }
   set_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = 12 }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = {
    check_variable = { var = yzm_mines^yzm_view_i value = 0 compare = equals }
    check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_view_i value = 1 compare = equals }
   }
   set_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = 14 }
  }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_view_i value = yzm_exploded compare = equals } } set_variable = { yzm_frames^yzm_view_i = 13 } }
 }
 add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_view_i = 1 }
}
# Scalar property caches use the same proven frame binding as vanilla posters.
set_variable = { yzm_tile_0 = yzm_frames^0 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_1 = yzm_frames^1 }

set_variable = { yzm_tile_57 = yzm_frames^57 }

set_variable = { yzm_tile_59 = yzm_frames^59 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_60 = yzm_frames^60 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_61 = yzm_frames^61 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_62 = yzm_frames^62 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_63 = yzm_frames^63 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_64 = yzm_frames^64 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_65 = yzm_frames^65 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_66 = yzm_frames^66 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_67 = yzm_frames^67 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_68 = yzm_frames^68 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_69 = yzm_frames^69 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_70 = yzm_frames^70 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_71 = yzm_frames^71 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_72 = yzm_frames^72 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_73 = yzm_frames^73 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_74 = yzm_frames^74 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_75 = yzm_frames^75 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_76 = yzm_frames^76 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_77 = yzm_frames^77 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_78 = yzm_frames^78 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_79 = yzm_frames^79 }
set_variable = { yzm_tile_80 = yzm_frames^80 }
set_variable = { yzm_face_frame = 1 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 2 compare = equals } } set_variable = { yzm_face_frame = 2 } }
else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { yzm_face_frame = 3 } }
set_variable = { yzm_left_count = 10 }
subtract_from_variable = { yzm_left_count = yzm_flags }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = yzm_left_count }
set_variable = { yzm_mine_h = 1 }
if = {
 limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_digits value = 0 compare = less_than } }
 multiply_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = -1 }
 set_variable = { yzm_mine_h = 11 }
}
set_temp_variable = { yzm_units = yzm_digits }
modulo_temp_variable = { yzm_units = 10 }
set_variable = { yzm_mine_u = yzm_units }
add_to_variable = { yzm_mine_u = 1 }
subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = yzm_units }
divide_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = 10 }
set_variable = { yzm_mine_t = yzm_digits }
add_to_variable = { yzm_mine_t = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_step_display = yzm_steps }
clamp_variable = { var = yzm_step_display min = 0 max = 999 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = yzm_step_display }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_units = yzm_digits }
modulo_temp_variable = { yzm_units = 10 }
set_variable = { yzm_step_u = yzm_units }
add_to_variable = { yzm_step_u = 1 }
subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = yzm_units }
divide_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = 10 }
set_temp_variable = { yzm_tens = yzm_digits }
modulo_temp_variable = { yzm_tens = 10 }
set_variable = { yzm_step_t = yzm_tens }
add_to_variable = { yzm_step_t = 1 }
subtract_from_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = yzm_tens }
divide_temp_variable = { yzm_digits = 10 }
set_variable = { yzm_step_h = yzm_digits }
add_to_variable = { yzm_step_h = 1 }
yzm_invalidate = yes

}

yzm_new_game = {
# Idempotent reset. Zero-sized resize clears old values before regrowing.
set_country_flag = yzm_v1
clr_country_flag = yzm_board_rewarded
set_variable = { yzm_status = 0 }
set_variable = { yzm_opened = 0 }
set_variable = { yzm_flags = 0 }
set_variable = { yzm_steps = 0 }
set_variable = { yzm_exploded = -1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mode = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_mines size = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_mines size = 81 value = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_counts size = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_counts size = 81 value = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_state size = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_state size = 81 value = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_frames size = 0 }
resize_array = { array = yzm_frames size = 81 value = 0 }
yzm_refresh = yes
}

yzm_open_window = {
if = {
 limit = { is_ai = no }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = yzm_v1 } } yzm_new_game = yes }
 set_country_flag = yzm_open
 yzm_refresh = yes
}
}

yzm_close_window = {
clr_country_flag = yzm_open
remove_decision_on_cooldown = yz_parquet_open_table
yzm_invalidate = yes
}

yzm_debug_board = {
# Console-only fixture: alternating mines on the top two rows, plus cell 80.
yzm_new_game = yes
set_variable = { yzm_mines^0 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^2 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^4 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^6 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^8 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^10 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^12 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^14 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^16 = 1 }
set_variable = { yzm_mines^80 = 1 }
yzm_recount = yes
set_variable = { yzm_status = 1 }
yzm_open_window = yes
}

yzm_debug_finish = {
# Acceptance helper calls the actual reveal effect for each safe cell.
if = {
 limit = { has_country_flag = yzm_v1 check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 0 compare = equals } }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_input = 40 }
 yzm_reveal = yes
}
if = {
 limit = { has_country_flag = yzm_v1 check_variable = { var = yzm_status value = 1 compare = equals } }
 set_variable = { yzm_mode = 0 }
 set_temp_variable = { yzm_debug_i = 0 }
 while_loop_effect = {
  limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_debug_i value = 81 compare = less_than } }
  if = {
   limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_mines^yzm_debug_i value = 0 compare = equals } }
   set_temp_variable = { yzm_input = yzm_debug_i }
   if = {
    limit = { check_variable = { var = yzm_state^yzm_input value = 1 compare = equals } }
    yzm_flag = yes
   }
   yzm_reveal = yes
  }
  add_to_temp_variable = { yzm_debug_i = 1 }
 }
}
}
